finding: getMemoryRequired clamps max_lh_slots to leafNum-2 before checking min_lh_slots=log2(leafNum)+LH_MIN_CONST. For sufficiently small trees the cap itself can trigger the Too low -mem warning despite ample requested RAM. Treat this as a small-tree allocation diagnostic, not evidence the 2G argument failed. Numerical rare-state and near-zero-branch warnings remain substantive.
